title: MRC Global Featured in Stainless Steel World Americas
summary: MRC Global was recently featured in the Stainless Steel World Americas cover article, 'Beyond the Material: How MRC Global Helps Industry Get Stainless Steel Right.'
body_markdown:
MRC Global was recently featured in the Stainless Steel World Americas cover article, *Beyond the Material: How MRC Global Helps Industry Get Stainless Steel Right* . The article highlights MRC Global's stainless steel and alloy business and the company's extensive quality program that helps ensure customers receive reliable products that meet ASTM/ASME standards.


[Click here to read the full article](https://ssw-americas.com/beyond-the-material-how-mrc-global-helps-industry-get-stainless-steel-right/)


> “Customer engineers understand and request the types and grades of material needed for their specific applications. MRC Global assists them in identifying the best sourcing option to meet their project needs.”
>
>
> -Buddy Berry, Director of Stainless Steel & Alloy Sales


**About MRC Global**
MRC Global is a leading global distributor of pipe, valves, fittings (PVF) and infrastructure products and services to diversified end-markets, including gas utilities, downstream, industrial and energy transition. With over 100 years of experience, MRC Global has provided customers with innovative supply chain solutions, technical product expertise and a robust digital platform from a worldwide network of locations, including valve and engineering centers. The company’s unmatched quality assurance program offers approximately 200,000 SKUs from over 7,100 suppliers, simplifying the supply chain for over 8,300 customers. For more information, visit the website:[www.mrcglobal.com](https://www.mrcglobal.com/)


**About Stainless Steel World Americas**
*Stainless Steel World Americas* is part of the KCI Group of Companies. They are a leading knowledge, communication and information company connecting business-to-business professionals by building and sustaining global communities, solving their information needs and helping them to develop their professional life and friendships. To find out more, visit the website:[ssw-americas.com](https://ssw-americas.com/)
